verdict.rationale: Logseq has a search bar and a `{{query}}` / `/query` simple-query feature for asking questions of the knowledge base. Community users describe it as offline-first with local data, so search plausibly works offline. However, the evidence never documents full-text search or filters on tags, properties, or paths. A hands-on report also says indexing and responsiveness slow down massively on large graphs, which undercuts 'instantly'. Missing for 10: explicit full-text search documentation, documented tag/property/path filters, evidence of fast search on large graphs, first-party confirmation that search works offline.
